verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents linking a bank account with automated reconciliation and transaction workflows. It also accepts card and ACH payments natively and offers embedded FreshBooks Payroll as part of keeping the books organized, so all three sources named in the story are first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that payment and payroll activity posts automatically to ledger accounts, detail on which banks or third-party payment and payroll providers can be connected, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically

citations.quote: FreshBooks lets you link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management
Keep your books organized with 100+ integrations and automations like embedded payroll and bank reconciliation.
Get paid with credit and debit cards, ACH bank transfer, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Buy Now, Pay Later
